tob-10078: Quaker scholar Rufus Jones profiles the spiritual reformers of early modern Europe. tob-4178: Saadi’s Gulistan — the Rose-plot — is Persia’s dearest wisdom-book, mingling prose tales with verse on kings, holy beggars, and life’s conduct. a-history-of-modern-europe-1792-1878: Charles Alan Fyffe's history carries Europe from the French Revolution through the unification of Germany — the age of Napoleon, nationalism, and empire. chantry-house-pg7378: Charlotte Yonge's Chantry House — an old home, its ghosts of the past, and the family within. Her last great novel of English country life. Yonge's world at its most complete. Old Colonel Keith and young Grisel tell their stories with Yonge's best art.
arxiv-2605-08778: Attackers rarely break a chatbot's safeguards with a single message; they wear it down across many turns of conversation. arxiv-2605-08878: Even carefully aligned chatbots can be jailbroken, and Yu Chen and Yuanhao Liu dig into why. arxiv-2605-08978: AI agents that reason step by step tend to exploit what already works instead of exploring what might. plos-pone-0355478: Do we conform to AI the way we conform to other humans? This paper studied conformity to AI versus humans, testing social exclusion and task type as moderating factors. plos-pone-0356478: After a drug-eluting stent is placed, re-narrowing — restenosis — remains the feared complication. plos-pone-0355978: When toxic algae bloom, shrimp pay the price in their hepatopancreas — the digestive powerhouse. plos-pone-0354678: Real-time weight monitoring could transform behavioral weight loss — but the physiology needs understanding first. plos-pone-0342878: What evidence actually supports new drug approvals — and is it changing? This paper tracked the changes in evidence used for FDA Novel Drug Approvals from 2016 to 2024. plos-pone-0356378: Measuring iron inside mouse brain tumors — in living animals versus excised tissue — demands method comparison. This paper compared in vivo and ex vivo iron quantification methods. The validated approaches let cancer researchers track iron’s role in tumor biology with confidence.
plos-pone-0354978: Predicting healthcare costs for older adults requires models validated on real data. plos-pone-0354878: Diffusion bonding joins metals without melting — but joint strength depends on process parameters. plos-pone-0351878: Massage for cancer patients — soothing or risky? This systematic review and meta-analysis examined the harms of massage in persons with cancer or receiving treatment. plos-pone-0355278: Children needing critical care and surgery — the barriers their families face are often invisible to the system. plos-pone-0354278: Earthquake-shattered zones — Meizoseismal areas — punish foundations differentially. This paper compared dynamic responses of single piles versus pile groups there. plos-pone-0354378: Alpine saline-alkaline soils — brutally challenging — need forage oats that yield reliably. plos-pone-0354478: Elite rugby players — their medial menisci extruding under load. This cross-sectional ultrasonography study measured extrusion in highly competitive players. plos-pone-0353878: Sex and circadian clocks — chronotype and behavior differences in healthy older adults. This paper explored them. plos-pone-0352578: Traditional villages’ public space justice — measured through villagers’ perceptions where old and new coexist. This paper did so. The findings quantified fairness in shared space. plos-pone-0352678: Ethiopian women with HIV — lived experience of depression in Gondar’s health facilities, phenomenologically studied. This paper heard them.
